Joint regional inference for paired single-cell pseudobulks

Source: R/leviSingleCellStatistics.R
leviSingleCellRegionalInference.Rd

Computes graph-connected cluster mass and explicit two-dimensional LEVI areas for every selected cell type. Treatment labels are swapped within donors and the null stores the maximum region mass across cell types, directions and regions, controlling the complete search family.

leviSingleCellRegionalInference(
  counts,
  donor,
  cell_type,
  condition,
  networkCoordinatesInput,
  networkInteractionsInput = NA,
  fileTypeInput = "dat",
  min_cells = 10L,
  cell_types = NULL,
  threshold = 2,
  n_perm = 999L,
  permutation_method = c("auto", "monte_carlo", "exact"),
  max_exact = 50000L,
  seed = NULL,
  normalize = c("TMM", "none"),
  BPPARAM = SerialParam(),
  ...
)

Arguments

counts

Genes-by-cells raw count matrix with gene row names.

donor, cell_type

One donor and cell-type label per cell.

condition

Two-level condition label per cell; every donor must contribute cells to both levels within each analysed cell type.

networkCoordinatesInput, networkInteractionsInput, fileTypeInput

LEVI network inputs: node coordinates, optional interactions and the file type accepted by [levi()].

min_cells

Minimum cells in each donor-condition-cell-type pseudobulk.

cell_types

Optional cell types to analyse. By default, types with a complete donor-by-condition pseudobulk set are used.

threshold

Absolute moderated-t threshold for graph cluster formation.

n_perm

Number of Monte Carlo within-donor label permutations.

permutation_method

`"auto"`, `"monte_carlo"` or `"exact"`. `"exact"` enumerates every distinct label assignment; `"monte_carlo"` draws `n_perm` random permutations; `"auto"` uses the exact scheme when the number of assignments is at most `max_exact` and Monte Carlo otherwise.

max_exact

Maximum number of label assignments enumerated by the exact permutation scheme.

seed

Optional RNG seed.

normalize

Library-size normalisation applied before the log2 counts-per-million transform: `"TMM"` (trimmed mean of M-values via edgeR, the default) or `"none"` (plain counts per million).

BPPARAM

A [BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam] object controlling how the permutations are evaluated. The default runs them serially.

...

Landscape arguments passed to [levi()] (for example `resolutionValueInput` or `region_threshold`). Do not supply expression, network, signal mode, permutation or inference arguments.

Value

A list of graph-cluster and two-dimensional landscape regional tests.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("limma", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  genes <- c("HUB", paste0("N", 1:8))
  # Five paired donors: 32 within-donor swaps; 19 Monte Carlo draws here
  # keep the example fast.
  donor <- rep(paste0("d", 1:5), each = 4)
  condition <- rep(rep(c("ctrl", "stim"), each = 2), 5)
  cell_type <- rep(c("A", "B"), times = 10)
  counts <- matrix(rpois(length(genes) * length(donor), 20), length(genes),
    dimnames = list(genes, NULL))
  out <- leviSingleCellRegionalInference(counts, donor, cell_type, condition,
    system.file("extdata", "hub_network.dat", package = "levi"),
    min_cells = 1, threshold = 1, n_perm = 19,
    permutation_method = "monte_carlo", seed = 1,
    resolutionValueInput = 1, region_threshold = .02)
  out$cluster_mass$A$summary
}
#>      Region Direction Nodes     Mass PeakStatistic PeakGene Genes PSpatial
#> 1   over_01      over     1 3.351058      3.351058       N4    N4     0.15
#> 11 under_01     under     1 1.344402     -1.344402       N3    N3     1.00
#> 2  under_02     under     1 1.020936     -1.020936       N7    N7     1.00
#>    Significant
#> 1        FALSE
#> 11       FALSE
#> 2        FALSE
